facts.fact: Law no. 2013-015 of 21 May 2013, adopted by the National Assembly on 9 May 2013 and promulgated, lets a data controller transfer personal data to a foreign state in article 11 when the receiving state's protection is found sufficient by the data protection authority, or by the authority's decision where a transfer is covered by contract clauses or internal rules; the document gives no repeal.
